children: On October 5, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq Determination Letter stating it is not compliant with Listing Rule 5620(a) for failing to hold an annual shareholders meeting within 12 months of fiscal year-end. The company has 45 days to submit a compliance plan and, if accepted, may receive up to March 29, 2027 to regain compliance. Trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market continues under the symbol IBAC with no immediate impact.
